description: Tokenization and morphology via StanzaEngine (Hebrew model). Wave 6a: infra smoke. Wave 6b: lemma paradigms, POS consistency, morph features, multi-sentence, determinism.
notes: Gold calibrated against stanza 1.11.1. All cases use sentences as input (not isolated words) to get stable POS from model context. Fem noun forms have separate lemma from masc (כלבה→כלבה, not כלב): Stanza design, not a bug. Pronoun fem (היא) → lemma הוא: Stanza design. See 'known_limitations' section below.

cases.description: Single interjection — שלום. 1 token, no morphological features. Tests: minimum non-empty input.

tokens.notes: INTJ has no features in Hebrew Stanza model. morph='' (empty string, not None).

cases.notes: Minimum valid case. Proves: process() returns non-empty output for 1-word input; INTJ POS assigned; lemma equals surface form; morph is empty string (not null).

cases.description: Definite article prefix + noun + verb — הכלב רץ. Tests Hebrew prefix detachment: 'הכלב' splits into [ה DET, כלב NOUN].

tokens.notes: Definite article detached from noun. Surface 'הכלב' → 2 tokens: ה + כלב.
Masculine singular noun.
Past tense verb. morph_contains used (not exact) for version robustness.

cases.notes: Key C02 contract: Hebrew definite article prefix is detached by Stanza tokenizer.

cases.description: Noun + adjective — ספר גדול. Tests basic NOUN/ADJ POS assignment.
cases.notes: Tests NOUN+ADJ sequence — pattern central to NP extractor (C05).

cases.description: Noun+Adj masculine plural — ספרים גדולים. Tests: masculine plural reduces to masculine singular lemma.

tokens.notes: Plural noun ספרים reduces to singular lemma ספר. Lemma paradigm: ספר/ספרים → ספר.
Masculine plural adjective reduces to masculine singular lemma גדול.

cases.description: Definite plural NOUN+ADJ — הספרים הגדולים. Tests: double DET prefix detachment; both noun and adj retain correct lemma after detachment.

tokens.notes: First DET — detached from הספרים.
Plural noun, lemma=ספר (masc sing).
Second DET — detached from הגדולים.
Plural adj, lemma=גדול (masc sing).

cases.notes: Two DET prefix detachments in one sentence → 4 tokens from 2 surface words.

cases.description: Feminine singular NOUN+ADJ — עיר גדולה. Tests: fem adj גדולה reduces to masc lemma גדול.

tokens.notes: Feminine singular noun עיר. Lemma equals surface form.
Fem sing adj גדולה → lemma גדול (masc sing). Adj lemma paradigm: all gender/number forms → גדול.

cases.description: Feminine plural NOUN+ADJ — ערים גדולות. Tests: fem plural noun reduces to fem sing lemma; fem plural adj reduces to masc sing lemma.

tokens.notes: Fem plural noun ערים → lemma עיר (fem sing). Note: fem noun lemma = fem sing base, not masc.
Fem plural adj גדולות → lemma גדול (masc sing). All adj forms share the same masc sing lemma.

cases.notes: Contrast with noun: noun lemma is the base form of the specific gender (עיר fem), adj lemma is always masc sing (גדול).

cases.description: Verb past 3rd-masc-sing in sentence context — הוא כתב ספר. Tests: verb gets Tense=Past, lemma=כתב.

tokens.notes: Past 3ms verb. Sentence context required for VERB POS (isolated 'כתב' gets NOUN).

cases.notes: Important: 'כתב' in isolation → NOUN (journalist/article). In sentence context with pronoun subject → VERB. C02 gold always uses sentence context.

cases.description: Verb past 3rd-fem-sing — היא כתבה ספר. Tests: fem verb form כתבה → same lemma כתב as masc form.

tokens.notes: Fem pronoun היא → lemma הוא (masc). Model-calibrated: Stanza uses masc as canonical pronoun lemma.
Fem past verb כתבה → lemma כתב (same as masc form כתב). Verb lemma is gender-independent.

cases.notes: Two calibrated-by-design facts: (1) fem pronoun → masc lemma; (2) verb lemma is gender-independent across conjugations.

cases.description: Verb past 3rd-plural + plural noun — הם כתבו ספרים. Tests: plural verb כתבו → lemma כתב; plural noun ספרים → lemma ספר.

tokens.notes: Masc plural pronoun הם → lemma הוא. Calibrated by design.
Plural past verb כתבו → lemma כתב. All three past forms (כתב/כתבה/כתבו) share lemma כתב.
Plural noun ספרים → lemma ספר.

cases.description: Multi-sentence input — 'ספר גדול. עיר גדולה.' Tests: 2 sentences produced; sentence.text includes terminal period; PUNCT token included in each sentence.

tokens.notes: Terminal period is tokenized as PUNCT token. morph='' (no features). Stanza includes it inside the sentence, unlike C01 SentenceSplitter.
Second sentence also includes PUNCT token.

cases.notes: C01↔C02 boundary finding: StanzaEngine processing multi-sentence text directly produces sent.text WITH terminal period ('ספר גדול.'). This differs from C01 SentenceSplitter which detaches punct. In production, sentences from C01 are passed to C02 one at a time without terminal punct.

cases.description: Infinitive לכתוב in sentence context — אני רוצה לכתוב ספר. Tests: infinitive POS=VERB, lemma=כתב, VerbForm=Inf emitted; no Tense/Gender/Number/Person features for infinitive.

tokens.notes: 1st person pronoun אני → lemma הוא. Calibrated by design (same as all pronouns).
Infinitive: VerbForm=Inf present; no Tense, no Gender, no Number, no Person emitted by Stanza. morph='HebBinyan=PAAL|VerbForm=Inf|Voice=Act'.

cases.notes: Infinitive lemma=כתב matches past/present/future paradigm. Morph for infinitive omits all inflection features — only VerbForm=Inf + HebBinyan + Voice. This is different from all conjugated forms.

cases.description: Present tense masc sing — הוא כותב ספר. Tests: כותב pos=VERB, lemma=כתב, Tense=Pres, VerbForm=Part, Gender=Masc, Number=Sing, Person=3.

tokens.notes: Present tense: VerbForm=Part distinguishes present from past. HebBinyan=PAAL (not checked — version-sensitive).

cases.description: Present tense fem sing — היא כותבת מכתב. Tests: כותבת pos=VERB, lemma=כתב, Tense=Pres, VerbForm=Part, Gender=Fem. Known quirk: HebBinyan=PIEL (not PAAL) and Person=1,2,3 (ambiguous) — calibrated by design.

tokens.notes: Calibrated quirk: כותבת → HebBinyan=PIEL (not PAAL) and Person=1,2,3 (Stanza treats כותבת as morphologically ambiguous). Neither of these is tested in morph_contains — only Tense/VerbForm/Gender/Number are stable.

cases.notes: כותבת quirks: (1) HebBinyan=PIEL vs PAAL — Stanza assigns PIEL here, model calibrated. (2) Person=1,2,3 — Stanza emits comma-separated person list for ambiguous present-fem-sing forms. Both are design, not bugs.

cases.description: Present tense masc plur — הם כותבים ספרים. Tests: כותבים pos=VERB, lemma=כתב, Tense=Pres, VerbForm=Part, Gender=Masc, Number=Plur.
Present tense fem plur — הן כותבות מכתבים. Tests: כותבות pos=VERB, lemma=כתב, Tense=Pres, VerbForm=Part, Gender=Fem, Number=Plur.
Future 1st person sing — אני אכתוב ספר. Tests: אכתוב pos=VERB, lemma=כתב, Tense=Fut, Person=1, Number=Sing.

tokens.notes: Future: no VerbForm=Part/Inf. HebBinyan not pinned (HIFIL in calibration but version-sensitive).

cases.notes: Object noun must be ספר, not מכתב. מכתב after future verbs starting with aleph is stable, but other conjugations (תכתוב/יכתוב/נכתוב) cause Stanza to split מכתב into [מ ADP + כתב NOUN] due to מ-prefix ambiguity. ספר is a safe disambiguation object for future tense gold cases.

cases.description: Future 2nd person masc sing — אתה תכתוב ספר. Tests: תכתוב pos=VERB, lemma=כתב, Tense=Fut, Person=2, Gender=Masc, Number=Sing.
Future 3rd person masc sing — הוא יכתוב ספר. Tests: יכתוב pos=VERB, lemma=כתב, Tense=Fut, Person=3, Gender=Masc, Number=Sing.
Future 1st person plur — אנחנו נכתוב ספר. Tests: נכתוב pos=VERB, lemma=כתב, Tense=Fut, Person=1, Number=Plur.
Future 2nd person masc plur — אתם תכתבו ספרים. Tests: תכתבו pos=VERB, lemma=כתב, Tense=Fut, Person=2, Gender=Masc, Number=Plur.
Future 3rd person plur — הם יכתבו ספרים. Tests: יכתבו pos=VERB, lemma=כתב, Tense=Fut, Person=3, Number=Plur. Known: Gender=Fem,Masc (dual gender for 3pl future — calibrated).

tokens.notes: Calibrated: Gender=Fem,Masc (dual gender in morph string) for 3rd person plural future. Stanza emits both genders as the 3pl future form is gender-common in Hebrew. Not a bug.

cases.notes: 3pl future יכתבו morph contains 'Gender=Fem,Masc' — both genders listed. This is calibrated against stanza 1.11.1. Do not assert Gender=Masc alone for this form.

cases.description: Future 3rd person fem sing — היא תכתוב ספר. Tests: תכתוב pos=VERB, lemma=כתב, Tense=Fut, Person=3, Gender=Fem, Number=Sing. Same surface form as 2ms (אתה תכתוב) but different morph Gender.

tokens.notes: Same surface form as FUT_02 (אתה תכתוב), but subject pronoun context changes morph: Gender=Fem, Person=3 here vs Gender=Masc, Person=2 in FUT_02. Proves subject-pronoun context drives morph disambiguation.

cases.notes: תכתוב is ambiguous: can be 2ms or 3fs. Stanza resolves via subject pronoun context. This is deliberate model design, not ambiguity bug.

cases.description: Mixed-tense multi-sentence — past + present + future in 3 sentences. Tests: 3 sentences produced; all verb tokens get lemma=כתב; tense tags differ per sentence; PUNCT tokens present.
cases.input_text: הוא כתב ספר. היא כותבת מכתב. הם יכתבו ספרים.
cases.notes: Cross-tense multi-sentence: all three verb forms (כתב/כותבת/יכתבו) produce lemma=כתב. Tense tags differ per sentence. PUNCT tokens included per sentence (consistent with C02_MS_01 pattern from Wave 6b).

known_limitations: Fem noun forms have a DIFFERENT lemma from masc: כלבה→lemma כלבה (not כלב), כלבות→lemma כלבה. By design: Stanza treats masc and fem noun forms as separate paradigms.
Pronoun canonicalization: all pronouns (הוא/היא/הם/הן/אני/אתה/אנחנו/הן) map to lemma הוא. Model-calibrated, not a bug.
Context-dependency: isolated words may get different POS than in sentence context. Gold always uses sentence context for stability.
כותבת (pres fem sing) quirks: HebBinyan=PIEL (not PAAL) and Person=1,2,3 (ambiguous person). Calibrated by design — not tested in morph_contains.
Future tense מ-prefix ambiguity: מכתב after future verbs starting with ת/י/נ splits into [מ ADP + כתב NOUN]. Future gold cases use ספר/ספרים as object to avoid this. Known Stanza limitation.
Future 2fs form (את תכתבי): את parsed as ADP (not PRON), verb gets wrong person/gender. Context-dependent pronoun ambiguity. Not covered — document only.
Future 3pl (יכתבו): morph contains Gender=Fem,Masc (dual gender). Calibrated by design.
Infinitive morph: no Tense/Gender/Number/Person emitted. Only VerbForm=Inf + HebBinyan + Voice. Different from all conjugated forms.
Construct state (סמיכות): 'בית ספר' (school) — not tested. Stanza may split compound or treat as single token.
